user.title: Read-only entity mapping
user.description: Shadow analysis only. No heater commands, service calls, MQTT writes or cloud requests. Defaults are owner-reported entity IDs; select your local entities. Schedule comes from the vendor-mode sensor, not the water-heater state.

init.title: Edit read-only sources
init.description: Mappings take effect after the settings step. Reload waits for a new normal cloud poll; it never requests one.

settings.title: Shadow assumptions and tariff contract
settings.description: No setting enables heater control. Leave verification flags OFF until meter sign/units and your actual tariff have been checked. Zero default prices and the flat placeholder period are NOT your contract. Days: Monday=0 to Sunday=6. Periods use off_peak, shoulder or peak; cover every minute of the week exactly once. local follows Tasmania DST; standard is fixed UTC+10. Targets and margins are model assumptions only.
